scope: ctxbar Shadow flyout <select> label truncation (UI polish) — LEDGER row 11c
cellNote: Not an audit manifest cell (no primitive/tone-law fill cell covers a UI control's label rendering) — bespoke Playwright capture against the real dev server per AGENT-PROTOCOL's 'no cell covers your unit' clause.

fix.declaration: overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap;
fix.scopeRationale: Scoped to .ctxbar-fly-ctl (every ctxbar scene-flyout row's control host) so ALL flyout selects get the fix, not just the Shadow flyout's dutyConst row (per the ledger's 'check the whole roster' instruction) — while leaving the docked panel's own (wider) .ctrl-sel instances, which the U9b-2/U5b-4 reviewer confirmed render the label in full, untouched.

liveVerification.method: Playwright against the real dev server on port 8482 (nohup node scripts/dev-server.js 8482), driving window.app + Vectura.UI.ContextBar directly (app.renderer.setSceneSelection + CB.restoreState() + pill.click(), the same real production path the U9b-2/U5b-4 reviewer used) — not a synthetic createElement mount.
liveVerification.before: Pre-fix (49a5ef88/eb9707a8 CSS): select shows "Duty Cycle · Constar" — clipped mid-word, no ellipsis (matches the reviewer's proven-pre-existing finding).
liveVerification.after: Post-fix: select shows "Duty Cycle · Const…" — a real ellipsis, not a raw clip. getComputedStyle: textOverflow=ellipsis, whiteSpace=nowrap (overflow reports 'visible' per Chromium's native <select> computed-style quirk, but the rendered ellipsis is real and confirmed visually).
screenshots: ctxbar-dutyConst-row-native-fixed.png — the Fill Style row alone, native resolution, post-fix
ctxbar-dutyConst-flyout-full-fixed.png — the whole Shadow flyout, post-fix

testCoverage.test: U5b-5 — every ctxbar scene-flyout <select> (.ctxbar-fly-ctl .ctrl-sel) declares text-overflow: ellipsis, not a raw clip
testCoverage.method: jsdom has no real CSS layout/paint engine (getComputedStyle cannot reproduce actual text clipping in this harness), so — matching the repo's established pattern for CSS-only regressions (tests/unit/css-on-tokens-and-no-transition-all.test.js) — the test pins the fix at the CSS-source level: reads src/ui/skin/components.css and asserts the .ctxbar-fly-ctl .ctrl-sel rule declares overflow:hidden, text-overflow:ellipsis, white-space:nowrap.
testCoverage.red: Reverted components.css to the eb9707a8 (pre-fix) blob in the live worktree, re-ran -t "U5b-5": FAILED (rule regex matched null — expected true, received null). Then restored the fixed file.
testCoverage.green: Restored components.css with the fix; re-ran -t "U5b-5": 1 passed | 176 skipped (177).

barsChanged: None — new CSS rule and one new additive test only; no existing numeric threshold, tolerance, or fingerprint touched.
notContained: No other row in the ctxbar Style/Shadow flyouts was found broken by this fix — the selector only ADDS overflow handling, it does not change any element's width or position. Only the .is-caveat / other unrelated content in the flyout was visually spot-checked incidentally and looked unaffected.
